Confusing WHAT justice requires (public safety) with WHO controls the outcome (judicial discretion insulated from community norms).

Judicial actors protect institutional autonomy through lenient pretexts, projecting fairness while failing victims. Only external billionaire pressure shatters the stasis, proving accountability requires viral force.
